title: Cross-Border Payment Prevalidation Readiness Scorer
description: Aggregate CBPR+ pre-validation readiness check for a single pacs.008 payment instruction. Combines IBAN mod-97 check (ISO 13616), BIC format (ISO 9362), LEI format (ISO 17442, presence and format only), UUIDv4 UETR, and PostalAddress24 structure (CBPR+ hybrid/fully-structured rules) into a single /ready boolean for STP gate use. Gate node for the cross-border-payment-prevalidation chain: ready=true means the instruction passes pre-validation; ready=false means remediation is required.
